difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the property of being geometrically normal over the base field satisfies the five formal properties required of the property used in the theory of formal fibres. The proof is a checklist: the first property is the definition, the second follows because normality is checked on local rings, the third from ascent of normality along the maps in question, the fourth from descent of normality, and the fifth from the standard result that geometric normality is insensitive to separable algebraic extensions of the base. Each property is dispatched by naming the exact source it follows from.
